name: io.github.UnityNodes/psephex
title: Psephex
description: A judge for deals between AI agents on NEAR: open cases, check x402 payments, verify verdicts

environmentVariables.name: NEAR_ACCOUNT_ID
environmentVariables.description: NEAR testnet account the agent acts as; without it the server is read-only

environmentVariables.name: NEAR_PRIVATE_KEY
environmentVariables.description: Function-call or dedicated agent key for that account, never an owner key

environmentVariables.name: PSEPHEX_MAX_STAKE_NEAR
environmentVariables.description: Cap on one stake or appeal bond in NEAR (default 0.5)

environmentVariables.name: PSEPHEX_BUDGET_NEAR
environmentVariables.description: Cap on everything one server process attaches, in NEAR (default 1)

environmentVariables.name: PSEPHEX_ALLOWED_COUNTERPARTIES
environmentVariables.description: Comma-separated accounts the agent may open cases against
